hold_text: Tier-2 (auth surface) and MERGING IS THE DEPLOY on this repo (ict-git-sync pulls ~5 min). Operator decisions D1 (new web_sessions table), D2, D3 recorded 2026-10-11 on row UI-UPGRADE-1-AUTH approve the BUILD; the manager reviews and merges. Safe to deploy dark: SITE_AUTH_ENFORCE defaults OFF so every existing route is unchanged (pinned by tests/test_web_site_auth.py::test_enforce_off_*), and the new /api/auth/* routes answer 503 auth_unavailable until GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and WEB_SESSION_PEPPER are set on the VM. Do NOT flip SITE_AUTH_ENFORCE from this PR; that is a separate operator set-env after a passkey is enrolled and the 24h Caddy-log consumer check (design 2b) reports. NEW DEPENDENCY: webauthn (requirements.txt) - the VM needs pip install on deploy.
why: UI-UPGRADE-1-AUTH build steps 1-2: non-browser consumer inventory (design 2b: 33 groups / 42+ files, static grep, completeness pending the 24h Caddy check), POST /api/auth/google (verify_oauth2_token, aud, email_verified, ALLOWED_EMAIL -> 5-min pre-auth ticket), WebAuthn register (pre-auth + one-time enrolment code, or an existing device session) and assert (sign counter enforced, challenge single-use), hashed 30-day sliding device sessions in the new web_sessions table (trade_journal.db), GET/DELETE /api/auth/sessions, 60s single-use ws-ticket, and an app-level require_site_session behind SITE_AUTH_ENFORCE (default OFF). Public regardless: preflight, /api/health, /api/diag/*, prop report/phone bearers, /api/auth/*. Existing password login untouched; existing require_session additionally accepts a ws_ device-session token.
